places.name: National Flag Memorial
places.ai_summary: Iconic, massive monument complex in Rosario dedicated to the Argentine flag, first raised here by Manuel Belgrano. Features a tower with panoramic views, civic courtyard, triumphal arch, and eternal flame. Located on the Paraná River waterfront.

opening_hours.Monday: Monument exterior accessible 24/7; Tower/Gallery hours vary (approx 09:00-18:00)
opening_hours.notes: Check official website for tower/gallery/museum hours

places.best_time_to_visit: Year-round, clear days for tower views
places.place_tip: Climb the tower (elevator available) for excellent views of the city and river. Visit the Hall of Flags.
places.address: Santa Fe 581, S2000 Rosario, Santa Fe, Argentina

places.name: Parque de la Independencia
places.ai_summary: Rosario's largest urban park, home to several attractions including the Newell's Old Boys stadium, Museum of Fine Arts (Castagnino), Historical Museum, Children's Garden, lake with paddle boats, and the Rosedal (rose garden).

opening_hours.notes: Public park; check hours for museums, etc.

places.place_tip: Good for walking, relaxing, or visiting the museums within. Rent paddle boats on the lake.
places.address: Parque de la Independencia, Rosario, Santa Fe, Argentina

places.name: Río Paraná Waterfront Walkway
places.ai_summary: Extensive network of walkways, parks, and recreational areas along the bank of the Paraná River in Rosario. Popular for walking, jogging, cycling, rollerblading, and enjoying river views. Connects several parks and landmarks, including the National Flag Memorial.

opening_hours.notes: Public walkway/park system

places.place_tip: Rent bikes for a longer exploration. Popular spots include Parque de España, Parque Sunchales (near MACRO museum), and the area around the Flag Memorial.
places.address: Costanera de Rosario (Various sections), Rosario, Santa Fe, Argentina

places.name: Monumento a la Bandera Observation Deck
places.ai_summary: Refers to the tower ('Torre') section of the National Flag Memorial complex, which offers an observation deck accessible by elevator, providing panoramic views over Rosario, the Paraná River, and the surrounding area.

opening_hours.notes: Check official monument website for current tower access hours

places.place_tip: Offers the best high viewpoint in the city center. Elevator access.
places.address: Santa Fe 581, S2000 Rosario, Santa Fe, Argentina

places.name: Cathedral Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary
places.ai_summary: Rosario's main Catholic cathedral, located near the waterfront and Flag Memorial. A Minor Basilica with neoclassical architecture, housing the image of the Virgin of the Rosary, the city's patron saint.

opening_hours.notes: Check locally for specific opening hours outside mass

places.place_tip: Visit while exploring the Flag Memorial area. Admire the architecture.
places.name_english: Cathedral Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary
places.address: Buenos Aires 789, S2000 Rosario, Santa Fe, Argentina

places.name: Museum of Contemporary Art (MACRO)
places.ai_summary: Rosario's Museum of Contemporary Art, housed in converted grain silos on the Paraná River waterfront (Parque Sunchales). Known for its distinctive colourful exterior and focus on contemporary Argentine art.

opening_hours.notes: Hours can vary, check official website

places.place_tip: Located on the riverfront north of the city center. Interesting architecture and location. Check current exhibitions.
places.address: Av. Estanislao López 2250, S2000 Rosario, Santa Fe, Argentina
places.name_native: Museo de Arte Contemporáneo de Rosario (MACRO)

places.name: Planetario Luis C. Carballo
places.ai_summary: Municipal planetarium located within Parque Urquiza. Offers astronomy shows projected onto its dome, educational activities, and sometimes telescope viewings.

opening_hours.notes: Check official website or social media for current show schedules and booking info

places.place_tip: Good option for families or those interested in astronomy. Shows are typically in Spanish.
places.address: Parque Urquiza, Rosario, Santa Fe, Argentina

places.name: Che Guevara Birthplace Museum
places.ai_summary: Apartment building where Ernesto 'Che' Guevara was born in 1928. While not a formal museum open to the public inside the apartment, the building is marked, and there might be related exhibits or cultural spaces nearby focusing on his early life.

opening_hours.notes: Private apartment building; no public access inside birthplace apartment

places.place_tip: View the plaque on the building exterior. For museum exhibits on Che, visit Alta Gracia (Córdoba province) where he spent part of his childhood.
places.address: Entre Ríos 480, S2000 Rosario, Santa Fe, Argentina

attribution.description: Faculty of Law of the National University of Rosario, Argentina, on the Paseo del Siglo historic district.

places.name: El Círculo Theatre
places.ai_summary: Historic and architecturally significant theatre in Rosario, known for its excellent acoustics, ornate European-style interior, and hosting opera, classical music, ballet, and theatre performances.

opening_hours.Monday: Box office hours; performance times vary
opening_hours.Tuesday: Box office hours; performance times vary
opening_hours.Wednesday: Box office hours; performance times vary
opening_hours.Thursday: Box office hours; performance times vary
opening_hours.Friday: Box office hours; performance times vary
opening_hours.Saturday: Box office hours; performance times vary
opening_hours.notes: Check website for performance schedule, box office hours, and guided tour availability

places.place_tip: Check the schedule for performances or inquire about guided tours to see the beautiful interior.
places.advanced_booking: Required for performances; recommended for tours
places.address: Laprida 1223, S2000 Rosario, Santa Fe, Argentina

places.name: Parque España Riverside
places.ai_summary: Cultural complex and park located on the downtown Rosario waterfront, featuring distinctive architecture (designed by Catalan architect Oriol Bohigas), green spaces, and views of the Paraná River and the Rosario-Victoria Bridge.

opening_hours.Monday: Open 24 hours (park area); cultural center hours vary
opening_hours.notes: Public park; check event/cultural center schedule

places.place_tip: Pleasant spot for river views near the city center. Part of the longer waterfront walkway system.
places.address: Sarmiento y el Rio Paraná, S2000 Rosario, Santa Fe, Argentina

places.name: La Florida Beach
places.ai_summary: Popular sandy beach area along the Paraná River in the northern part of Rosario. Features bars, restaurants, sports facilities, and swimming areas (check water quality advisories). A lively spot, especially in summer.

opening_hours.notes: Paid access to balneario (managed beach area) in summer; check specific facility hours

places.place_tip: Can get very crowded on summer weekends. Check water suitability for swimming. Accessible by bus or car.
places.advanced_booking: Not required (possible fee for balneario access)
places.address: Balneario La Florida, Av. Eudoro Carrasco, Rosario, Santa Fe, Argentina

places.name: Children’s Museum of Rosario
places.ai_summary: Interactive museum designed for children ('Museo de los Niños'), located within the Alto Rosario shopping mall. Offers educational exhibits and play areas focused on recreating city life and various professions.

opening_hours.notes: Hours vary significantly, check official website or mall hours

places.place_tip: Located inside a shopping mall. Good option for families with young children, especially on rainy days.
places.advanced_booking: Not usually required, tickets at entrance
places.address: Alto Rosario Shopping, Junín 501, S2000 Rosario, Santa Fe, Argentina

places.name_native: Museo de los Niños Alto Rosario

places.name: Parque Urquiza
places.ai_summary: Large park situated on a bluff overlooking the Paraná River. Features the Municipal Planetarium, an amphitheater, sculptures, green spaces, and viewpoints.

opening_hours.notes: Public park; check planetarium/amphitheater schedules

places.place_tip: Offers good views of the river and city skyline. Location of the planetarium.
places.address: Parque Urquiza, Rosario, Santa Fe, Argentina

places.name: Costanera Norte Bike Path
places.ai_summary: Section of the Rosario waterfront walkway system in the northern part of the city, popular for cycling, running, and walking. Passes parks, beaches (like La Florida), and offers views of the Paraná River and the Rosario-Victoria Bridge.

opening_hours.notes: Public path

places.place_tip: Good for recreational activities. Bike rentals often available nearby or through city programs.
places.address: Av. Costanera Intendente Luis Cándido Carballo, Rosario, Santa Fe, Argentina

places.name: Plaza San Martín
places.ai_summary: Another important historic square in Rosario (distinct from the main one in Córdoba). Features gardens, fountains, and an equestrian statue of General San Martín. Surrounded by government buildings and banks.

opening_hours.notes: Public square

places.place_tip: Located downtown, a few blocks from the pedestrian shopping street (Peatonal Córdoba).
places.address: Plaza San Martín, Dorrego y Santa Fe, Rosario, Santa Fe, Argentina

attribution.description: The intersection of San Martín St. and Córdoba St. in downtown Rosario, Argentina. At this intersection, both streets are for pedestrians only.

places.name: Municipal Museum of Fine Arts
places.ai_summary: Museo Municipal de Bellas Artes Juan B. Castagnino, located in Parque de la Independencia. Houses an important collection of Argentine and European art from the 15th century to the present, including paintings, sculptures, and engravings.

opening_hours.notes: Hours can vary, check official website

places.place_tip: Located within the large Independence Park. Check for temporary exhibitions.
places.address: Av. Pellegrini 2202, S2000 Rosario, Santa Fe, Argentina
places.name_native: Museo Municipal de Bellas Artes Juan B. Castagnino

places.name: Mercado del Patio (Food Market)
places.ai_summary: Modern gastronomic market housed in a renovated historic railway building. Features numerous stalls selling fresh produce, meats, cheeses, baked goods, regional specialties, plus food court areas and restaurants.

opening_hours.notes: Individual stall hours may vary; check website

places.place_tip: Good place to sample local products, grab lunch, or buy edible souvenirs. Located near the bus terminal.
places.address: Cafferata 729, S2000 Rosario, Santa Fe, Argentina

places.name: Calle Córdoba Shopping District
places.ai_summary: Refers to the pedestrianized section of Córdoba Street ('Peatonal Córdoba') in downtown Rosario. Main shopping street lined with clothing stores, department stores, cafes, and other retail businesses.

opening_hours.notes: Street accessible 24/7; check individual store hours

places.place_tip: Main commercial hub for shopping in the city center.
places.address: Peatonal Córdoba (between Laprida and Paraguay approx), Rosario, Santa Fe, Argentina

places.name: Sculpture Walk
places.ai_summary: Refers to various sculptures located along Rosario's waterfront parks and promenades, particularly in Parque Sunchales near the MACRO museum, showcasing works by contemporary artists.

opening_hours.notes: Outdoor public art

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to MACRO or a walk/cycle along the Costanera Norte.

places.name: Rosario City Hall
places.ai_summary: The Municipal Palace ('Palacio de los Leones'), Rosario's city hall, is an impressive building facing Plaza 25 de Mayo (near the Cathedral and Flag Memorial). Known for its French Renaissance architecture and two lion statues guarding the entrance.

opening_hours.Monday: Exterior viewable 24/7; Interior access likely limited
opening_hours.notes: Government building; interior access usually restricted

places.place_tip: Admire the architecture while visiting the nearby Cathedral and Flag Memorial.
places.address: Buenos Aires 711, S2000 Rosario, Santa Fe, Argentina
